# MambaHR

> MambaHR is the AI HR department for US companies — the system of record (HRIS + ATS + LMS) with a coordinated set of specialist agents that run the operational HR work end to end. One human approves the calls that matter; everything else runs itself.

## What MambaHR actually is

MambaHR is a standalone web application at app.mambahr.com. Not a Slack bot. Not a chatbot. Not an add-on to another HRIS. It IS the system of record — HRIS + ATS + LMS in one. The product handles the full HR operating surface — hiring, onboarding, leave (PTO + FMLA + state law), performance reviews, compensation, compliance, offboarding, terminations, documents — with specialist agents coordinated by a single primary agent and one human-in-the-loop policy screen.

MambaHR does not run payroll. It generates payroll-ready change files in your provider's format (ADP, Workday, Gusto, Rippling, and others) for you to upload. Owning the regulated payroll run is a future capability, not the current product.

## Who it's for

- US companies, 2 to 500+ employees
- Heads of People, CHROs, Chief People Officers replacing legacy HRIS stacks (Workday, Rippling, Gusto, BambooHR, Namely, HiBob, ADP, Deel)
- Founders running HR off Notion docs and spreadsheets
- Lean people teams that want to grow the company without growing HR headcount

## What makes MambaHR different

- **Agents do the work, not just notify.** Where competing tools surface a question or generate a draft, MambaHR's agent reads the policy, checks eligibility, drafts paperwork, files records, notifies stakeholders, and writes the audit trail. End to end.
- **Federal + 50-state employment law, cited on every decision.** Compliance is reasoned about, not just stored — FMLA × state paid-leave stacking, multi-state pay transparency, exempt classification — each decision carries the rule it followed.
- **Always-you safety.** Terminations, RIFs, separation agreements, offers above band, and comp changes above your threshold are always routed to a human. Never automated.
- **Hiring intelligence is advisory.** Candidate and internal-mobility matching is advisory only — a human makes every hiring decision.
- **1-day setup.** Imports from any HRIS in a day. Live the next morning. No 4-to-8-week deployment.
- **One screen of policy.** Approval thresholds, leave rules, comp ranges, sign-off gates — configured on a single page. Edit anytime.

From $14 per employee / month, billed annually ($10k/yr minimum). Pricing is based on managed headcount, not user seats. Tiers scale up for larger teams; enterprise from $100k/yr. See https://mambahr.com/pricing.

## Product surfaces

### The Today queue
The main daily workspace. Each item is a card showing what the agent decided to do, why, and (if it needs sign-off) two buttons: Approve / Decline. Cards are tagged with one of three statuses:
- **Auto-approved** — the agent handled it within policy. No human action.
- **Needs your sign-off** — judgment call inside the policy boundary. You approve or decline.
- **Always you** — high-stakes by design (terminations, RIFs, comp above threshold). Never automated.

### The specialist agents
A primary agent coordinates specialists, each owning an HR domain end to end:
- Hiring — sources and screens (advisory), drafts offer letters, files I-9, orders equipment, provisions accounts
- Onboarding — first-week calendars, buddy assignment, training schedules, document collection
- Offboarding — revokes access across systems, computes state-aware final pay (human-approved), drafts separation packets
- Leave — PTO, parental leave, FMLA, and state-specific leave (CA CFRA, NY PFL, MA PFML, CO, and others)
- Payroll exports — builds the per-cycle change file in your provider's format for you to upload (MambaHR does not run payroll)
- Compliance — answers policy questions with citations from federal + 50-state law
- Compensation — pulls market bands, runs pay-equity analysis, drafts raise recommendations (human-approved)
- Performance — ingests goals and evidence, drafts cited review narratives, supports 9-box calibration
- Benefits — enrollments, qualifying life events, COBRA, 401(k)
- Records & documents — employee records, versioned document management, append-only audit trail
- Training (LMS) — assignments, completions, mandatory state-required training
- Reporting — EEO-1, headcount, turnover, custom queries

### Sign-off model
The agent classifies every action by who decides: itself (auto), you (sign-off needed), or you only (always-you). You configure the thresholds on the policy screen. Examples:
- PTO request within policy: auto
- New hire offer above band: needs your sign-off
- Termination: always you
- RIF: always you

## Compliance scope

- Federal: FLSA, FMLA, ADA, ADEA, FCRA, GINA, USERRA, IRCA, EEO frameworks
- All 50 state codes + DC: labor codes, paid leave, accrual rules, final-pay timing, separation notice requirements
- Multi-state AI-in-hiring law coverage (e.g. NYC Local Law 144, Illinois, Colorado, California) — hiring intelligence is advisory and disclosed
- US privacy: CCPA / CPRA
- Encryption: AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit
- Audit log: immutable, exportable
- US data residency. Never trained on customer data — contractual guarantee. You own the data; MambaHR is a processor, not a controller.

## Market

US-only. MambaHR sells to US companies and handles US federal and 50-state employment law. (Note: MambaHR does not claim SOC 2 certification.)

## Migration story

MambaHR imports from your existing HRIS in a single day — a one-time data migration at onboarding, not an ongoing sync. Supported source systems include Workday, Rippling, Gusto, BambooHR, Namely, HiBob, ADP, and Deel. ATS pipeline data imports from Greenhouse and Lever.

What gets migrated: employees, comp records, org chart, reporting lines, leave balances, performance history, documents (offers, agreements), benefits enrollments.

## Integrations

- Intent capture (inbound): Slack, Microsoft Teams, email, web request form
- Identity / SSO: Okta, Azure AD — account provisioning on hire and termination
- E-sign: DocuSign
- Background checks: Checkr
- Devices (MDM): Jamf, Kandji, Intune
- Benefits: Guideline (401k), Lively (HSA/FSA)
- Comms: Slack, Teams, Google Workspace

## Comparison highlights

- **vs. Workday** — Workday is configuration software requiring implementation consultants and ongoing admin teams. MambaHR is an autonomous department that sets up in a day.
- **vs. Rippling** — Rippling is a unified suite of dashboards. MambaHR is the department that operates on top of that surface — you don't manage workflows; the agent does.
- **vs. Gusto / BambooHR** — Built for small business and dashboard-first. MambaHR scales the same agent across company sizes with the same one-day setup.
- **vs. Namely / HiBob** — Same category but dashboard-first. MambaHR is action-first: agents do the work, humans approve.
- **vs. Deel** — Deel pays global contractors. MambaHR runs your domestic US HR.
- **vs. ADP** — ADP is the back office. MambaHR is the front line of HR operations.
